title: Powers of an element with smooth free localization are strictly standard
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a ring map of finite presentation and $a\in A$ such that $A_a$ is a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and $\Omega_{A_a/R}$ is a stably free $A_a$-module (for instance free). Then there is an integer $e_0\ge1$ such that $a^e$ is strictly standard in $A$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element] for every $e\ge e_0$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07EZ (lemma-compare-standard, line 719), part (e) [(2) => a^e strictly standard for e >= e_0], with (3) => (2) of part (a) for free Omega
